chunks: O man, why do you not see your own lameness and remain within bounds,
and why do not you realize the shortness of your measure and stay back where destiny has placed you.
You have no concern with the defeat of the defeated or the victory of the victor.
You are wandering in bewilderment and straying from the right path.
ai.seo_question: What does Nahj al-Balagha say about human limitations and destiny?
ai.summary: In his letter to Muawiya, Imam Ali (AS) critiques the Umayyad ruler's political ambition by highlighting the transient nature of worldly power and the inevitability of divine decree (Qadr). He warns that despite Muawiya's efforts to establish dominance, he remains a wanderer in spiritual confusion, detached from the true purpose of leadership and the Hereafter.
